preparation_checklist: Bring a valid photo ID to all pantry visits (required at Interchange and St. Mark AME; helpful elsewhere).
Call The Gathering at (414) 272-4122 to confirm no appointment is needed before your first visit.
Call SVdP Harambee Kitchen (414) 249-3866 and Cross Roads Kitchen (414) 649-9555 to confirm walk-in access and cost.
Call Salvation Army Citadel (414) 463-3300 to confirm Thu/Fri pantry hours and whether appointment is needed.
Call COA Goldin Center (414) 265-7696) before Sat Sep 12 and Wed Sep 16 visits — hours unverified since 2024.
At every pantry, ask specifically for no-cook, shelf-stable, or ready-to-eat items — you have no kitchen.
Carry a reusable bag for pantry pickups.
Check MCTS bus routes to each site at ridemcts.com or call 414-344-6711.
